description: App freezes and shows ANR dialog after several seconds of use, input dispatching times out
root_cause: Main thread blocked by a long-running operation (network or disk I/O) during input handling
recommended_action: Move blocking work off the main thread; use StrictMode to catch offending calls

description: App crashes immediately on launch with a NullPointerException in onCreate
root_cause: Null reference accessed before initialization completed, typically an uninitialized field used in onCreate
recommended_action: Add null checks and verify initialization order in onCreate

description: App crashes with OutOfMemoryError after heap grows repeatedly
root_cause: Unbounded object allocation (often bitmaps or caches) not released, exceeding Java heap limit
recommended_action: Profile heap allocations, add bitmap recycling and cache size limits

description: Device reboots unexpectedly during video playback or 3D game with no app-level crash
root_cause: GPU command buffer fault or hang in the Adreno/kgsl driver during hardware-accelerated rendering
recommended_action: Capture a GPU trace, check for driver updates, file a bug against the GPU driver team

description: Background app silently disappears, user loses unsaved state, no crash log shown
root_cause: Kernel lowmemorykiller terminated the background process to reclaim memory under system pressure
recommended_action: Reduce background memory footprint, persist state proactively, request higher process priority if justified

description: Device runs noticeably slower and warm during sustained CPU-intensive workloads like video encoding
root_cause: Thermal throttling engaged after CPU temperature exceeded the safe operating threshold
recommended_action: Reduce sustained CPU load, add adaptive quality settings, check for a thermal design issue if throttling is frequent

description: Camera app crashes with a fatal error shortly after opening the camera
root_cause: The camera HAL/service crashed and the app's StateCallback did not handle the resulting disconnection
recommended_action: Handle CameraDevice.StateCallback.onError and onDisconnected gracefully, retry camera open with backoff

description: Device hard-reboots with a kernel BUG or spinlock assertion in the kernel log
root_cause: Kernel-level locking bug (e.g. double-unlock of a spinlock) triggering a fatal BUG() and panic
recommended_action: Capture the full kernel panic backtrace and file against the kernel/driver subsystem identified in the trace

description: A system service becomes unresponsive and Binder transactions start failing
root_cause: Binder transaction buffer exhaustion or a dead remote service causing transaction failures
recommended_action: Check for Binder transaction leaks (oversized payloads, missing unbinds) and remote service crash logs

description: App heap grows continuously across screens until an OutOfMemoryError eventually occurs
root_cause: Memory leak — objects (often Activity/Context references) held longer than their intended lifecycle
recommended_action: Use LeakCanary or heap dumps to find retained references, fix lifecycle-scoped listeners and static references
